fields.proposed_value: Discovery call with Pampa Agro. Field reps visit about 200 dealers weekly, and visit reports are paper, typed into a spreadsheet on Fridays, so orders and promises are not known. The team wants one place for dealer visits, orders and promises, working offline with GPS check-in, live by July 2027. Orbita will send an offline-mode video; a field demo with two reps is set for 11 Nov.
